properties.name: vita.poi.excel.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Excel starter.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.default-head-row-number
properties.description: Default head row number used during import.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.max-error-rows
properties.description: Maximum number of import error details retained in the result.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.trim-cell-value
properties.description: Whether to trim cell text during import.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.ignore-empty-row
properties.description: Whether to ignore empty rows during import.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.auto-close-stream
properties.description: Whether EasyExcel should close the caller provided stream automatically.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.in-memory
properties.description: Whether write operations should use in-memory mode.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.use-default-style
properties.description: Whether EasyExcel default style is enabled.

properties.name: vita.poi.excel.default-sheet-name
properties.description: Default sheet name used when export/fill requests do not provide one.
